fields.Name: Re-embed Local Vectors
fields.Description: Re-embeds persisted local vectors (agent notes and examples, tags, queries, components) that were produced by a model other than the platform's default local embedding model (the MJ_DEFAULT_LOCAL_EMBEDDING_MODEL environment variable, else the highest-PowerRank active local model). Run it after changing the default local embedding model, and with Force=true after an upgrade that changed what a local model produces. Each row is saved through its entity, which re-embeds it. It first checks that the model can embed, so a model that fails to load changes nothing. Safe to re-run: without Force, rows already on the default model are skipped. Restart the MJ server processes afterwards so their in-memory indexes reload. Entity search vectors are not covered; run entity vector sync for those.

fields.Name: EntityNames
fields.Description: Optional comma-separated list of entities to re-embed: MJ: AI Agent Notes, MJ: AI Agent Examples, MJ: Tags, MJ: Queries, MJ: Components. Default: all of them.

fields.Name: DryRun
fields.Description: When true, only count the rows per entity (stale rows, or every embedded row with Force); nothing is saved. Default: false.

fields.Name: Force
fields.Description: When true, re-embed every stored local vector, including rows already recorded as the default model. Use after an upgrade that changed what a model produces under the same model ID. Default: false.

fields.Name: Report
fields.Description: Per-entity counts: the target model's name, and for each entity the rows found to re-embed (Found), rows re-embedded (Reembedded), rows that failed (Failed), and why a run stopped early (Error).
Every stale row was re-embedded (or, on a dry run, counted).
Some rows could not be re-embedded; see the Report output and the server log. Re-run to retry them.
The run could not start or a view failed, e.g. no active local embedding model or an unknown entity name.
